Leave Total at 0 for a pass/fail completion certificate with no score shown.

Set your own category names, mark thresholds, and colours — the bottom row is the failing / re-training tier and always applies when marks fall below every other row's minimum.
Leave on Auto to calculate from the marks above, or pick a category yourself whenever you need to override it. Selecting the bottom-tier category automatically switches the certificate wording to reflect that the assessment wasn't met.
Printing produces two full A4-landscape pages: your selected certificate design, then the evaluation result sheet / score card. Scanning the certificate's QR code shows the score card details instantly — works offline, no server required.
